scope: Actual completed travel run: 5 model responses, 33,749 reported tokens. One overlong interests argument was rejected; subsequent WebIQ destination and weather calls returned real observations. Exact-date forecast coverage was not verified.

scope: Actual follow-up in the same conversation reached export_itinerary_pdf on its first model response, with no repeated research. The proposal was pending when captured. This is not a saved PDF.

title: Step 9 - Denial without a PDF
scope: The proposal was denied through the browser. The actual tool observation reports denied:true, the PDF endpoint returned 404, and an independent filesystem check found no PDF. No email, calendar, PDF or preference write was approved.
